chunks: He said: "Do you know what you did to Joseph and his brother in your ignorance?"
ai.seo_question: What did Jacob ask his sons about their treatment of Joseph?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (Ya'qub) confronts his sons with the rhetorical question 'Did you not know?' (أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوا), emphasizing that they acted in a state of *jahiliyyah*—spiritual ignorance and heedlessness—despite their lineage of prophecy. Shia exegetes highlight that this *jahiliyyah* refers not to a lack of intellect, but to a temporary lapse in divine awareness, underscoring the gravity of their betrayal which led to years of separation and eventual reconciliation.
